name: Maintenance Delegate Action 11
definition: Information for the MTM to build or include delegated actions in the management plan of the POI.

PeriodicAction.name: Periodic Action
PeriodicAction.definition: Flag to indicate that the delegated actions have to be included in a periodic sequence of actions.| Usage: When absent, default value is False.

TMRemoteAccess.name: TM Remote Access
TMRemoteAccess.definition: Network address and parameters of the terminal manager host which will performs the delegated actions.

TMSProtocol.name: TMS Protocol
TMSProtocol.definition: TMS protocol to use to perform the maintenance action.

TMSProtocolVersion.name: TMS Protocol Version
TMSProtocolVersion.definition: Version of the TMS protocol to use to perform the maintenance action.

DataSetIdentification.name: Data Set Identification
DataSetIdentification.definition: Data set on which the delegated action has to be performed.

ReTry.name: Re Try
ReTry.definition: Definition of retry process when activation of the action fails.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Additional information to include in the maintenance action.

Action.name: Action
Action.definition: Sequence of action to include in the next MTM management plan.

OneElementPresenceRule.definition: At least one of these subelements mut be present.
